correctness.rationale: A full proof constructs the unique ground-field normal form via the Veronese restriction of quadrics, checks smoothness by matrix determinant, derives the rational chord tangency criterion by the adjugate of the second conic, proves the complete cycle decomposition by additive Fp cosets, tracks the quadratic character under finite extensions, and classifies rational PGL3 orbits by the exact affine stabilizer of order 2q. A separate SymPy checker verifies the exact conic, adjugate, coordinate-action and restriction identities; the independent coordinate-level Python checker exhaustively constructs graphs over F3,F5,F7,F11,F9,F25,F49 and independently counts smooth conics over F3 and F5. Finite checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: A paper proving geometric characteristic-p Poncelet periodicity in the fourfold-contact case does not imply rational chord existence or rational polygon counts: distinct rational square classes have opposite behavior. The closest published rational count concerns the geometrically different triple-contact case and expressly excludes fourfold contact. Direct searches and primary-material comparisons found no result covering the two square classes, full rational graph, extension formula or orbit census. Residual historical equivalence risk is recognized.

value.rationale: Fourfold conic contact is a canonical degeneration in geometric Poncelet theory. The theorem determines a natural complete arithmetic dichotomy invisible over an algebraic closure: exactly one rational orbit class has q/p p-gons and the other no rational tangent-chords at all; over extensions the obstruction vanishes in even degree. The exact graph and rational-projective orbit census give structural information beyond a routine or isolated finite count.
